I think the dislike of subscription comes from three main sources:

  1. Kids who don't have a credit card or a big allowance and find it difficult to scare up time codes in stores, or convince their parents to let them charge their credit card every month. Obviously it's appealing to someone like that if they can just jump into a game for free.

  2. Casual players who jump from game to game or don't spend a ton of time in the games. If you aren't totally committed to an MMO and only have it because of that one friend who plays who you enjoy hanging with every other week, or you want to hop on it every few months just to see what's going on then a monthly sub just isn't worth it.

  3. The "I'm just waiting for ____" crowd. In every MMO you will find some hardcore players who basically have hit the point where they are just waiting for new content to be added, or certain issues to be fixed, or some other thing that they determined to be the remedy to their boredom. They might still log in to hang out with their guild, but they tend to feel like they shouldn't have to pay when they don't consider themselves to be playing the game.

So, there are some legit reasons to dislike subscription. For someone who really wants to commit to a game and make that one game their hobby it is the best business model though.
Also people who are sceptical of long term engagement. Don't want to go pumping a whole load of money into something you might stop playing or, worse, that will be shutdown and become unplayable
